# serviceunit

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/internal/domains/serviceunit"
```

Package serviceunit implements the ServiceUnit resource domain.

The ServiceUnit domain is responsible for managing the lifecycle of ServiceUnit resources. It receives commands from the Engine, resolves resource specifications into validated contracts, delegates processing to the application layer, and records reconciliation outcomes through conditions and events.
